description: Shared sbt plugin (new modules/sbt-purekafka-docs, Scala 2.12, sbtPlugin := true) that generates AsyncAPI static HTML documentation at build time (chained after Compile/compile), replacing each consuming service's own copy of generate-kafka-asyncapi-docs.sh/verify-kafka-asyncapi-docs.sh. Adds AsyncApiChannelsProvider trait + AsyncApiSpecWriter main-class to purekafka.docs. Verified end-to-end against kafka-harness.
